# Pump Maintenance SOP

Synthetic reference: WB-SOP-PUMP-001, revision 1

## 4.1 Inspection records

Record the equipment identifier, observation location, date, and available measurements.
Photographs support an observation but do not establish remaining wall thickness or leak rate.

## 4.2 Defect response and verification

For localized corrosion at a pump flange, record the affected location and obtain an approved
remaining-wall-thickness measurement before repair approval.

For oil seepage at a shaft seal, isolate the equipment under the applicable operating procedure,
measure the leak rate, and inspect the seal before deciding the repair scope.

When a coupling-guard fastener is missing, keep the equipment out of service until the fastener
is restored and the complete guard attachment is inspected.

## 4.3 Approval record

An approval note must distinguish observed facts from recommendations, cite the inspection record
and this procedure, and state measurements or information that remain unavailable.
